title: Implement VAD events, backpressure, and compliant errors
description: Extend `UnmuteHandler` VAD/pause detection to emit canonical `input_audio_buffer.speech_started/stopped` events, surface `error` events when silence timeouts or buffer backpressure hit spec limits, and ensure handler state resets appropriately. Update metrics and latency instrumentation. Add tests (unit for VAD thresholds, async integration verifying events + error emissions when STT queue stalls or silence exceeds thresholds).,timeout:120000,

title: Generate Jetson Thor performance validation plan
description: Develop load/perf test scripts that emulate robot workloads on Jetson Thor (audio ingest, STT, tool calls). Capture metrics (latency, GPU utilization) and feed into documentation; coordinate with profiling and health probe tasks.,timeout:120000,

title: Integrate conformance harness into CI
description: Wire the realtime conformance harness into CI: headless FastAPI + uvicorn spin-up, harness execution, artifact upload (event traces, latency metrics). Provide developer scripts for local runs and ensure failures block merges.,timeout:120000,

title: Add multimodal image & metadata ingestion
description: Extend client event handling in `main_websocket.receive_loop` (and handler state) to support `input_image_buffer.append` (or equivalent) and metadata modality items. Decode/store uploaded images and metadata references alongside audio so subsequent `response.create` calls can cite them when building LLM context. Update `UnmuteHandler`/LLM pipeline to attach these modality references and persist conversation state for reconnects. Provide tests with fixture images/metadata verifying state persistence and deterministic replay.

title: Implement realtime session reconciliation & event routing
description: Extend `unmute/main_websocket.py` (receive_loop/emit_loop) plus `unmute/unmute_handler.py` to accept the full set of client events (`session.update`, `response.create/cancel`, `conversation.item.*`, `input_audio_buffer.commit/reset`, etc.), maintain per-session state machines, and emit the required acknowledgements (`*.updated`, `response.completed`, `response.failed`, `conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.*`). Ensure recorder persistence stays deterministic when clients reconnect. Add async tests using FastAPI TestClient + in-memory handler stubs to simulate event sequences and verify state reconciliation + ack ordering.

title: Refactor realtime websocket handshake & capability negotiation
description:
Scope:
- In `unmute/main_websocket.py`, ensure `websocket_route` enforces `realtime` subprotocol, validates Authorization/OpenAI-Beta headers, and negotiates capability extensions (e.g., `unmute.extensions` list) from an initial `session.update` payload.
- Persist negotiated config on `UnmuteHandler` (voice, instructions, allowed extensions) and reject unsupported extensions with spec-compliant `error` events before closing.
- Wire additional auth/config validation helpers in `unmute/service_discovery.py` or a new module, covering rate limits and Jetson-specific configs.
- Update `scripts/example_websocket_client.py` to reflect required headers/subprotocols.
Testing:
- Add FastAPI TestClient websocket tests verifying handshake success/failure cases, extension negotiation, and auth errors.
- Include negative tests for missing subprotocol, unsupported extension, and malformed config payloads.

title: Profile realtime pipeline & mitigate bottlenecks
description: Instrument audio ingest, STT flushing, LLM streaming, and actuator response loops with async tracepoints; use profiling tools to find GIL contention or queue bottlenecks; implement fixes (task groups, bounded queues, StreamReader tweaks). Validate improvements on Jetson-like hardware and document results.

title: Route realtime tool calls to actuators with interrupts
description: Implement the end-to-end handling of `response.tool_call.delta/done` events inside `UnmuteHandler` (or dedicated module): map tool IDs to actuator microservice clients, dispatch payloads asynchronously, await responses/acks, and emit `response.tool_call.output` success/failure events. Add interrupt semantics allowing client-issued cancellations or VAD-triggered interruptions to abort in-flight actuator tasks safely, ensuring cleanup signals reach actuators. Provide integration tests with mocked actuator services verifying lifecycle, concurrency, and interrupts.

title: Document Jetson Thor realtime deployment
description: Produce deployment guidance for Jetson Thor boards: process layout, GPU sharing, CUDA versions, co-locating websocket/router/telemetry, and resource pinning to avoid starving STT/TTS. Capture profiling findings and recommended settings in `docs/jetson_thor_realtime.md` (or similar).,timeout:120000,

title: Build OpenAI Realtime conformance harness
description: Develop a Python-based harness (e.g., `tests/realtime_harness/`) that can replay canonical OpenAI trace fixtures (audio bursts, tool call sequences, multimodal inputs) against a headless FastAPI server, asserting event order, schema fidelity, and timing windows. Provide scripts to run locally and integrate with CI. Initial scope: happy-path traces and regression fixtures for protocol compliance.

title: Design per-session audio buffer manager
description: Implement a per-session audio buffer subsystem (new module under `unmute/` or `unmute/audio`) that stores `input_audio_buffer.append` frames with timestamps, sequence numbers, and codec metadata (PCM16/Opus). Integrate it with `main_websocket.receive_loop` and `UnmuteHandler.receive` so buffered frames feed the STT service via a streaming interface with explicit flush points and base64 validation. Update tests or add new coverage (unit tests for buffer ordering/windowing, integration tests that simulate append/flush and assert STT interactions + emitted transcription events).

title: Add harness fuzzing & latency benchmarks
description: Extend the conformance harness with fuzz generators that inject duplicate IDs, out-of-order frames, and malformed tool responses to confirm `error` event emissions. Add latency benchmarking (TTFT, STT flush, tool-call RTT) with configurable thresholds and reporting into CI artifacts. Update documentation on how to interpret failures.

title: Define actuator tool schemas
description: Create a reusable tool schema library (likely `unmute/tooling/tool_schemas.py`) describing each robot actuator command (`move_arm`, `rotate_base`, `play_sound`, `capture_frame`, etc.) with JSON-schema-like validation, argument typing, timeout budgets, and serialization helpers for LLM usage. Wire schemas into the LLM system prompt builder so `response.tool_call.*` payloads use shared definitions. Add targeted unit tests verifying schema validation and serialization.

title: Implement realtime health probes
description: Add readiness/liveness endpoints surfacing realtime capacity (STT backlog, LLM queue depth, actuator availability). Integrate with existing `get_health` metrics and ensure session admission control uses probe data to reject new sessions when latency SLAs at risk. Include automated tests for probe logic.

title: Track milestone validation & reporting
description: Define validation checklists for each milestone (Protocol MVP, Audio+Tool integration, Multimodal Ready, Harness Green, Jetson Validation), establish reporting cadence, and ensure dependencies with actuator/sensor teams are logged. Output living doc/Notion summary plus weekly updates via beads.,timeout:120000,

title: Implement realtime multimodal state persistence
description: Ensure conversation state (audio, text, images, metadata, tool results) persists and replays deterministically across reconnects. Update recorder/replay utilities plus state serialization in `UnmuteHandler` so clients can resume sessions. Test via simulated reconnect flows.

title: Expand OpenAI Realtime event models
description:
Scope:
- Audit OpenAI docs and diff against `unmute/openai_realtime_api_events.py`/`unmute/openai_realtime_api_events.pyi` to add all missing client/server event models (conversation items, response state transitions, tool call payloads, image buffers, metadata modalities, errors, ack events).
- Update the discriminated-union TypeAdapters in `unmute/main_websocket.py`, `unmute/scripts/example_websocket_client.py`, and recorder utilities so new models validate and serialize consistently.
- Ensure recorder replay + tests can round-trip newly added enums/fields; extend fixtures for anonymized audio events.
Testing:
- Add `tests/test_openai_realtime_events.py` with sample payload JSON fixtures covering every new event class and verifying `.model_validate_json()`/`.model_dump()` parity.
- Run targeted FastAPI websocket tests to confirm receive/emit code paths accept the expanded unions.
